Plugin.Name: Synology Hardware
Plugin.ExtraSearchTerms: synology ds2415 dx1215 fan led mac temperature
Plugin.Overview:
Runs a Synology DS2415+ (and a DX1215 expansion unit) under Unraid.
- Fans of both units from DSM's own fan tables, by the hottest disk and the CPU. Sleeping disks are never woken, and the fan is never set below 10 %. - Front-panel LEDs, and orange bay LEDs from disk health. - The real MAC addresses, read from the DOM and applied at boot. - Settings, Synology Hardware: a live drawing of both units, bay map, temperatures, history graphs, a hardware inventory and bay badges on the Main page. - A Report tab that anonymises what your unit looks like, for support of other models.
For a DX1215 and the bay LEDs, install the companion plugin, the Synology Expansion Unit Driver.
Experimental. Only the DS2415+ and DX1215 are supported.
